WEBQSP_ROG_MID.new_this_session: A ~1.008 GB falsifiable candidate identified: NSM's released webqsp.tgz + CWQ.tgz
WEBQSP_ROG_MID.reason: NSM's released per-question subgraphs are MID-keyed output of the exact recipe RoG says it followed, but RoG states it re-ran extraction, and RoG's split is 37 questions smaller than NSM's.

WEBQSP_KBQA_24M.reason: The 24.9M/164.6M artifact is PullNet's intermediate KB. PullNet released no code and no data. GraftNet's nearest relative freebase_prepro.tgz is on a host that no longer answers TCP and was never archived.

framing_corrections.finding: The figures originate in PullNet (Sun, Bedrax-Weiss, Cohen, EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019), section 4.1 Datasets, not GraftNet.
framing_corrections.verbatim_quote: We use Freebase as our knowledge base but for ease of experimentation restrict it to a subset of Freebase which contains all facts that are within 2-hops of any entity mentioned in the questions of WebQuestionsSP. This smaller KB contains 164.6 million facts and 24.9 million entities.
framing_corrections.source: arXiv:1904.09537, PDF pages 5-7 read in session
framing_corrections.refutes: Attribution of 24.9M/164.6M to the GraftNet paper. GraftNet pages 5-7 were read; the figures are absent.

framing_corrections.finding: WEBQSP_KBQA_24M is defined as the 2-hop union around WebQSP question entities. It is a filtered AND benchmark-conditioned Freebase substrate, not full Freebase, and it is NOT query-independent.
framing_corrections.consequence: Acquiring it would close a paper-comparability target, not the corpus-independence block in FREEBASE_SOURCE_PROPOSAL.md (it fails that document's S4 test).

framing_corrections.finding: idirlab/freebases publishes 46.07M-59.90M entities and 125.1M-244.1M triples across four variants. Nearest on triples (FB+CVT-REV, 134.2M) is 2.4x off on entities (59.9M vs 24.9M).
framing_corrections.naming_rule: A graph built from any idirlab variant MUST be named WEBQSP_FREEBASE_60M_SCALE (or _46M_SCALE), never KBQA_24M, and never compared head-to-head against PullNet/GraftNet/NSM/ReaRev numbers.
